purpose: Retain exact-source hosted Windows medium/high TUN packets, complete live snapshot, original PnP crash recovery and raw same-SID rejection. This is mechanism qualification, not full W22 target acceptance.

build_provenance.driver: Official unmodified Wintun 0.14.1 amd64; archive, all architecture DLL and binary-license hashes retained; actual Authenticode Valid/WireGuard LLC. The protected execution copy matched the Actions-built executable.

cases.normal: passed: distinct actual medium owner/high helper, exact original image identity and complete native snapshot; real IPv4/IPv6 full 1280-byte UDP request/reply; foreign same-SID process denied; original adapter absence and journal/receipt cleared
cases.nonoriginal_identity: passed: changed index, LUID, alias and GUID each refused by production exact-instance removal; complete original kernel snapshot and captured PnP instance unchanged after every rejection
cases.crash: passed: helper terminated without destructors; recovery refused retained live original ordinary process; ordinary process terminated; production recovery removed only captured original PnP instance, observed physical absence and cleared exact protected journal/receipt
cases.raw_peer: passed: distinct actual medium same-SID client sent the public hello and exact plan digest over the real named pipe; high helper refused its OS-reported nonoriginal PID before packet admission; final adapter/journal/receipt absent

prior_failed_attempt.failure: New negative fixture tried reopening the live helper's exclusively locked AdminJournal and received Win32 32 before its native identity assertions. No negative-case pass was claimed.
prior_failed_attempt.repair: b1c7282 observes the published protected receipt and native inventory, verifies its original attestation digest and leaves the production exclusive journal lock unchanged.

later_change_requires_new_evidence: 8a9f73a binds provider selection to the frozen official per-architecture binary and adds actual protected/mutable provider negative cases. Those changes are not qualified by this earlier run.

subsequent_hosted_formatting_only.scope: Downloaded patch digest matched its exact-source receipt; selected source blobs were unchanged before applying only those hosted formatting hunks. No local formatter, compilation or acceptance claim.

remaining_scope: Production login, one-use online packet authority, real remote carrier on independent Windows/Linux devices, partial-install faults and other-VPN coexistence still need applicable current-source evidence.
local_review: Downloaded retained Actions output and read/checksummed its files only. No local driver execution, project compilation, formatter, lint or test.
